features.statement: Page title is a short brand name rather than a long keyword-heavy SEO string.
Header is white or light with a thin bottom border and dark text navigation.
Logo emblem sits on a solid accent-colored square beside a bold dark text wordmark.
Phone number in the nav is a filled accent-colored button with rounded corners.
Hero h1 is large, bold, system sans-serif in title case, with an accent rule and italic serif subtitle.
Search or booking form is a narrower card placed beside the hero heading on the right.
Cards and panels have softly rounded corners instead of square ones.
Binary choice control is a segmented toggle with a filled dark active option.
Numeric quantity inputs are plain select dropdowns, and dates use native date inputs.
Form labels are small uppercase text with letter spacing, grouped within a fieldset.
Primary form submit is a full-width accent button with a centered underlined secondary link beneath.
Hero background image is darkened with an overlay or gradient behind the heading.
Sections open with a small uppercase accent eyebrow above a bold heading on a cream background.
Notices appear as tinted callout boxes with a thick accent left border and bold serif text.
Quick links are text buttons with arrow glyphs in bordered rounded boxes in a grid, without icon tiles.
Lists use plain text rows separated by thin divider rules, without icons.
Headings and UI use a system sans-serif while body paragraphs use a Georgia-style serif.
Accent color is a darker, muted rust or brick red, with warm cream and brown neutrals.
Links are underlined, in accent color on light backgrounds and white in the footer.
Call-to-action band is solid black with large bold white headline and an accent serif button.
Heading hierarchy is clean: section titles are h2 with item titles as h3.
Footer headings are small, bold, widely letter-spaced uppercase.
Footer is a single near-black warm column stack with plain text links and a divider before copyright.
Page uses semantic elements such as main, section and article with modern grid and flexbox layout.
Body text has a looser line height of about 1.65.
Content is constrained to a narrow centered width within full-bleed colored bands, with no shadowed outer column.
Markup is lean with few divs, spans, classes, scripts and ARIA attributes.
Visual effects are minimal, with few shadows, transitions and transforms.
Headings use sentence or title case rather than all caps, with friendly exclamation-marked microcopy.
